name: SEV-Step
impact: Single-stepping framework for AMD SEV (first generation); enables microarchitectural attacks on SEV VMs
mitigation: Disable debug API, constant-time code, cache partitioning
boundary_statement: SEV-Step (TCHES 2024) is a single-stepping framework for AMD SEV (first generation), not specifically AMD SEV-SNP. Enables microarchitectural side-channel attacks on SEV VMs.

INTENT.evidence: Title/abstract: 'A Single-Stepping Framework for AMD-SEV' (first generation). Not specific to SEV-SNP.
